title: NCAA: Letran ousts Mapua, arranges Final Four clash against JRU
summary: Colegio de San Juan de Letran ousted Mapua University, 86-75, to punch its Final Four ticket in NCAA Season 102 men's basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
